description: The unique identifier for a specific calendar date.
The month of the year (e.g., 1 for January, 12 for December).
The full name of the month (e.g., 'January', 'February').
The week number within the year (e.g., 1-53).
A boolean flag indicating if the date falls on a weekend (TRUE) or a weekday (FALSE).
A string representation of the year and month (e.g., 'YYYY-MM').
A string representation of the year and quarter (e.g., 'YYYY-Q#').
